Manage both rapid R&D test setups and long-term test infrastructure improvements. Test infrastructure achieves >99% uptime and predictable performance. Be the "Responsible Engineer" for test infrastructure including centrifuges, TVACs, prop test stands, prop fill carts, prop gas benches, prop water flow stands and torch test stands. jobs.description_text: The Senior Process Development Chemist owns the development and characterization of Voyager's chemical processes at laboratory scale by building fundamental process understanding. This includes investigation of reaction kinetics and thermodynamics, crystallization behavior, impurity rejection, and operating windows. The resulting data package forms the core starting point that engineering relies on to move each process safely and efficiently from bench to plant. This is not a role where you optimize conditions in isolation and hand off a number, but rather one where you design experiments that anticipate how a process will behave at scale and work iteratively alongside the chemical engineers who translate that data into production equipment. With facilities for oxidizers, energetic materials, and energetic precursors planned across Colorado and Louisiana in the coming years, this is also an opportunity to shape how process development is done from the ground up. As the first dedicated hire in this function, you could grow into building and leading a team as operations expand, though a strong individual contributor will find deep and meaningful work here from day one. The position reports to the Chief Engineer and is part of the Chemicals and Explosives Team. This fully onsite role is based in Penrose, CO with a shift to Pueblo, CO expected within the next year. jobs.description_text: About the Role As a Senior IAM Engineer on the Security team, you will set the standard for identity and access across Verkada, owning how access is defined, granted, reviewed, and revoked throughout our infrastructure. From codifying identity boundaries in Terraform and Rego to driving least privilege across AWS roles and policies on zero trust principles, your work will turn access management from a manual ticket queue into a self-service system powered by scripts and agentic workflows. What You'll Do Manage identity and access infrastructure as code in Terraform, with peer-reviewed change control, drift detection, and policy-as-code. Advance zero trust controls for engineering access: short-lived credentials, just-in-time elevation, and the elimination of standing privilege. Own the access lifecycle for both human and non-human identities: joiner/mover/leaver flows, service accounts, and agents. Operate access review and certification workflows that produce audit evidence. Write tools to surface over-permissioned identities, unused credentials, and policy drift; then drive remediation to completion. Build agentic workflows on a low-code orchestration platform to automate access requests, approvals, risk scoring, and access review campaigns. Partner with security, infrastructure, and product engineering teams so that the secure path is the easy path, and consult on IAM design for new services.
